biggest_catch: This is a limited-time promo (started May 1, 2026, can end anytime) - and the friend's checking account must accumulate $25 in deposits within 14 days of opening, or no one gets anything.
catches: Referring member earns a $50 cash bonus per referred new member who opens a qualified checking account (the max per referral for the referrer).
Qualified checking: Classic or Rewards Checking with at least $25 cumulative deposits within 14 days of the membership open date.
Friend must be 18+, a new member (never an account owner at CU SoCal), and name the referrer's name + email for tracking.
Referrer must be an active CU SoCal member; no limit on the number of referrals.
Bonus deposited within 60 calendar days after qualifying activities are completed and verified; accounts must be open and in good standing.
Bonuses may be subject to IRS 1099 tax reporting; promotion for a limited time, may be discontinued at any time.
Friend can earn up to $200 total via debit usage ($50), direct deposit ($50), and a consumer loan ($50) - referrer's bonus is capped at $50 per referral.
